name: North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd. provides military and civilian products in China. The company offers navigation control and ammunition information technology which covers guidance, navigation, detection, environmental, and stability control; satellite and ground communications; electrical connectors; unmanned patrol aircraft; and other products and technologies, as well as special vehicles. North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as China North Optical-Electrical Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2012. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
